newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch AND Int Publishers buys travel database.
newsitem.headline: Dutch AND Int Publishers buys travel database.

text.p: Dutch AND International Publishers Plc said on Tuesday it had bought the database of Dutch software producer TravelPlan BV for an undisclosed sum.
The database contains information about times of arrivals and departures of airplanes and trains around the world, which is sold as a software product for planning business travel.

AND's shares were floated on London's Alternative Investment Market (AIM) last July. The company posted a 1995 pre-tax net profit of 1.4 million guilders on turnover of 15 million. More than half of the company's income is generated through electronic publishing.
